verified_metadata.title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers
verified_metadata.abstract: A looped transformer performs inference by iterating a weight-tied map, making its computation a dynamical process whose cost is set by the resulting inference dynamics. Here we show that networks with identical architecture and objective, trained to identical accuracy, nevertheless realize distinct dynamical phases depending strongly on initialization, and that the bifurcation defining each phase determines how test-time compute scales. The phases are distinguished by their bifurcation mechanisms, including a saddle-node fold and a Neimark-Sacker-type transition to bounded nonstationary motion. In the fold phase, a one-dimensional normal-form reduction predicts both the relaxation-time and spectral-gap amplitudes from local derivatives of the trained map, yielding the parameter-free relation $τ(\varepsilon)[1-λ_{\max}(-\varepsilon)]\toπ$. Composed with a regular distribution of problem difficulty, the same critical slowing down produces the workload-level tail $P(τ>N)\sim N^{-2}$. In the Neimark--Sacker phase, the fold scaling law disappears rather than merely changing its prefactor. Thus, test-time compute is not determined by architecture alone. It is governed by the dynamical phase of the solution found by training.

sections.title: 作者信息
bullets: Gunn Kim：Department of Physics, Sejong University。

sections.title: 摘要
paragraphs: 相同架构、目标和 100% held-out accuracy 的 looped Transformer，仅因初始化不同就落入 fold、Neimark-Sacker、rigid 等不同推理动力学相。fold 相产生临界慢化与 $P(\tau>N)\sim N^{-2}$ workload tail；换到 Neimark-Sacker 相后该标度律直接消失。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: 一个训练完的 recurrent reasoner 需要多少迭代，究竟由 architecture 决定，还是由训练选中的固定点与分岔结构决定？

sections.title: 为什么进入 Daily
paragraphs: 把 test-time compute 从外部预算改写为训练选择的推理动力学相之 observable，并给出无参数临界关系。 本次遴选不是依据标题关键词或摘要热度：先从 2026-08-28 的官方 arXiv 分类清单锁定 v1 候选，再核对全文中的问题定义、方法、关键公式、实验或定理、限制条件和资源声明。该文按统一 40 分量表得到 37/40，达到 Daily 的 S 级门槛；分数只表示本网站本轮的相关性与证据完整度，不替代同行评议。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: weight-tied pre-norm attention+MLP block 在 latent state 上迭代，任务是证据中途撤走后保持符号决策。作者扫 memory pressure、三类初始化和 15 个网络，并以扩展系统定位 fold、以复特征值穿越单位圆识别 Neimark-Sacker。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
bullets: 固定 $\mu=0.5$ 的 10 次初始化产生 5 fold、1 Neimark-Sacker、1 rigid、3 monostable，且全部 accuracy 1.000；8/10 网络在 step 250 已呈最终相。
fold normal form 同时预测 $\tau\propto\varepsilon^{-1/2}$ 与谱隙 $1-\lambda_{\max}\propto\varepsilon^{1/2}$，乘积趋 $\pi$；regular difficulty density 再推出 $N^{-2}$ 计算尾。Neimark-Sacker 相不服从这条 fold collapse。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 论文仅 5 页，模型维度 $d=16$、受控二分类任务、显式 stationarity penalty；没有证据证明大型 reasoning LLM 或自然 CoT 也由同一分岔控制。结论是可证伪机制候选，不是通用推理定律。

sections.title: 证据审计
bullets: 全文核验锚点：paper.pdf pp. 1-2: model, phase classification, initialization dependence, and held-out accuracy; paper.pdf pp. 2-3: fold normal form, parameter-free relation, and workload-tail derivation; paper.pdf pp. 4-5: Neimark-Sacker contrast, scope, and concluding limitations。卡片中的定量结论只在这些页码和作者声明的设定内复述，未把理论极限、受控数值或小规模实验外推为生产系统结论。
来源边界：发现记录来自官方 arXiv listing，卡片由 Codex-direct 全文核验生成，provenance 固定为 Daily；它不是 Paper Collection 的人工收藏条目，也不会因 Collection 中存在同一论文而改变 Daily 的筛选结论。
复现边界：本轮完成的是 PDF、公式、图表/定理与元数据交叉检查，没有独立重跑训练、模拟或形式化证明。因而本文的证据强度按原作者提供的解析、数值或实验材料表述，不把‘已核读’写成‘已复现’。
